name_en: Pumping lemmas for regular and context-free languages
canonical_name: Regular-language and context-free-language pumping lemmas (collective source family; exact statement open)
literal_source_claim: 正则语言与上下文无关语言的泵引理 (the pumping lemmas for regular and context-free languages)
statement_blocker: The catalog intentionally bundles the regular-language and context-free-language pumping lemmas but gives no theorem-grade formulas or primary-source locator. It does not fix the alphabet and language encodings, pumping-length quantifiers, factor order, length/nonemptiness constraints, simultaneous-pumping convention, boundary cases, or whether the root is one conjunction with shared or branch-local binders. Choosing only the pinned DFA lemma would weaken the collective target; inventing the missing CFL branch would exceed intake.
domain_and_universes: Expected words are finite lists over an alphabet type. The regular branch additionally requires a finite state type or an equivalent regular-language witness; the context-free branch requires a selected grammar or language-level witness. Universe levels, alphabet finiteness, decidable equality, and whether branch alphabets are shared remain open.
conclusion: Expected collective family: both the source-selected regular-language pumping property and the source-selected context-free-language pumping property. Their exact ordered binders, decomposition clauses, bounds, and Lean conjunction or structure remain open.

candidate_scope_not_credited.regular_language_textbook_shape: For every regular language L, there exists p > 0 such that every w in L with p <= |w| decomposes as x ++ y ++ z with y nonempty, |x ++ y| <= p, and x ++ y^i ++ z in L for every natural i.
candidate_scope_not_credited.regular_dfa_shape: For a finite-state DFA M and accepted word w at least as long as the state-cardinality bound, DFA.pumping_lemma gives factors a, b, c and language inclusion {a} * {b}* * {c} <= M.accepts.
candidate_scope_not_credited.context_free_textbook_shape: For every context-free language L, there exists p > 0 such that every w in L with p <= |w| decomposes as u ++ v ++ x ++ y ++ z with |v ++ x ++ y| <= p, v ++ y nonempty, and u ++ v^i ++ x ++ y^i ++ z in L for every natural i.
candidate_scope_not_credited.collective_root_shape: A conjunction or explicitly indexed two-component bundle retaining both lemmas without sharing branch-local alphabets, witnesses, or pumping lengths unless a reviewed source requires sharing.
candidate_scope_not_credited.required_transports: DFA-level to Language.IsRegular, grammar-level to Language.IsContextFree, singleton/Kleene-star language inclusion to pointwise natural-power wording, and any branch-to-collective composition all require checked witnesses.

degenerate_cases_to_resolve: empty and singleton alphabets and empty languages

zero-state or empty state types versus a DFA structure that requires a start state
epsilon-generating context-free grammars and grammars with no productive rules
whether the regular decomposition bound is |x ++ y| <= p or |x| < p

whether natural pumping exponents include zero
associativity and factor-order conventions for five-way list concatenation
excluded_substitutions: proving only the regular-language lemma or only the context-free-language lemma
using the regular pumping property as an if-and-only-if characterization of regular languages
replacing the context-free pumping lemma by the stronger Ogden lemma without a checked implication to the selected branch
a pumping lemma for deterministic context-free, indexed, context-sensitive, omega, tree, or formal power-series languages
a finite-state loop decomposition that omits acceptance preservation for every pumping exponent
a decomposition assumed as a hypothesis, structure field, axiom, oracle, or unchecked certificate
THM-C-0133 or THM-C-0144 state, receipts, or artifacts transferred across target identity
